snippet.title: Mysteries of the House - Cinematic Trailer (Definitive)
snippet.description:
I redid the trailer because I wasn't really satisfied with it. The video quality of the gameplay scenes that I used previously sucked. I apologize to anyone who thought this was a new video... 💔

Thank you all so much for the support and reviews on Steam btw! :D 💙💙💙
